reAuditOfTheOneDifferingWindow.rule: the 1 s grid covers every second spanned by the file's rows (the published construction), forward fill at most 3 s

auditorAmbiguousRules: Key date part is the run date, not the file date: matched on time-of-day modulo 24 h.
V3 with NaN in paired series: onset=nanmean of the two onset rows; asymptote=nanmedian of last min(5,j-i) rows (NaN skipped), requires >=5 finite in rest.
Rest run taken as maximal consecutive cur<5 rows of the collapsed grid (removed seconds do not break a run).
V8 'both members before T0': max_t<T0 and min_t<T0; asymptote members both >=T0, pair time (later member) in [T1-5,T1).
V3 pair time grid: 1 s mean keyed by floor(second); ffill limit 3 over full second range of pairs before aligning.
Pair rule: first Min at or after Max time and before next Max; ties at equal timestamps accepted; <=1.5 s inclusive.
V6 fresh uses the G(3,3) fresh flags of Max and Min in the row's own second; current freshness not required.
